name: Holiday work under the 'inclusive' reading of the 300% (SRS Q13 answered the other way)
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases; the seed reads Q13 as in_addition until the chief accountant answers
derivation: Base 22,000,000, 22 working days, 8 hours a day: the hourly rate is 22,000,000 / 176 = 125,000 exactly. The policy multiplies the base salary only.

The case sets overtime.holiday_pay = inclusive: the 300% for hours worked on a public holiday includes the holiday's own salary, which the monthly salary has already paid. So the line pays 300% - 100% = 200% by day.
Holiday work 60 minutes at night: (300% - 100%) + 30% night premium + 20% extra for overtime at night = 250%; 125,000 x (60 x 250) / 6000 = 312,500. OT_HOLIDAY = 2,312,500.
For comparison, the seeded in_addition reading would pay 125,000 x 480 x 300 / 6000 + 125,000 x 60 x 350 / 6000 = 3,000,000 + 437,500 = 3,437,500.

PIT exemption, seeded mode 'premium_only': the ordinary pay for these hours is in the salary, so all of the line is premium and all of it is exempt. Taxable income = 24,312,500 - 2,312,500 = 22,000,000.
